issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify a no-argument method getTotalNumberOfStudents() that returns the total number of students. The solution implementation defines getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests) (i.e. it requires a boolean parameter). This parameter mismatch between the specification and the solution will confuse students and cause tests or expected usage (which expect a no-arg method) to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution to implement the no-argument method public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() that returns the total number of students (inscribed + guest) as specified in the UML and problem text. If conditional behavior (including or excluding guests) is desired, add an overloaded method public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests) in addition to the required no-arg version, but ensure the no-arg signature exists to match the specification and tests.
